result.question: What is the trend in Apple's research and development spending over the last three fiscal years?
result.answer:
Apple's research and development (R&D) spending has increased steadily over the last three fiscal years. In FY 2023 (period ending September 30, 2023), Apple reported R&D expense of $29,915 million [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2023-09-30]. In FY 2024 (period ending September 28, 2024), R&D expense rose to $31,370 million [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2024-09-28]. In FY 2025 (period ending September 27, 2025), R&D expense further increased to $34,550 million [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2025-09-27].

### Retracted claims

The following claims could not be verified against their cited sources and were removed from the answer:
- The year-over-year increase from FY 2023 to FY 2024 was approximately $1,455 million.
- The year-over-year increase from FY 2024 to FY 2025 was approximately $3,180 million.
